ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a schematic diagram of an aquatic food web. On the left there is the sun and it is labeled “sunlight”. At the bottom of the diagram there is the group “algae and macrophytes”, and arrows point from here to small aquatic animals such as water fleas and mayfly larvae; the bottom also shows “detritus” and “bacteria”. Reasoning: The question asks “What is a producer?” A producer is an organism that can make its own food, usually through photosynthesis, and is located at the base of the food web. In the diagram, what is at the bottom of the food web and provides food for other animals is “algae and macrophytes”; among them, algae can use sunlight to carry out photosynthesis, so it is a producer. The answer is Algae.
